# Customer and demand

> Customer discovery and demand estimation: interviews and surveys with their biases, experiments, discrete choice models, segmentation, and a protocol shape for a customer study. Scope only; the review is not started.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Customer and demand](https://tewf.github.io/business-customer/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/business-customer/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/business-customer/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
